pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 38

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 44

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
